entry.summary:
Join us for an introduction to LINZ's updated guidance on surveys to remove limitations. 

We'll cover the basics and what's changed, including when: 
- long-standing occupation can take precedence over title dimensions to define the extent of the land in the title 
- a boundary defined on a prior removal of limitations survey can be used to define the common boundary with the land under survey  
- new residue parcels can be created – only where occupation evidence supports a potential adverse possession claim  
- residue land from an adjoining cancelled limited title may be included in a removal of limitations survey without an adverse possession application.

This live webinar took place on 19 November 2025.

For more information on the updated guidance visit: https://www.linz.govt.nz/guidance/survey/cadastral-survey-guidelines/limited-title-surveys
